# MEND Medical Apparel

> Adaptive medical apparel and connected home-health devices for patients and the
> people caring for them. Recovery wear that keeps dignity intact, and monitoring
> that reaches the care team without a hospital visit.

Site: https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/

## Apparel

- [Comfort Wrap — Stylish Washable Hospital Gown](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20Stylish%20Washable%20Hospital%20Gown.html): A soft, machine-washable recovery gown that replaces the standard hospital gown, with full coverage and one-handed closures.
- [Comfort Scrubs — Residential Nurse Scrub Set](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20Residential%20Nurse%20Scrub%20Set.html): A tailored scrub set for residential and home-care nurses in a soft cotton/modal blend.
- [Medical-Grade Compression Socks](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20Compression%20Socks.html): 20-30 mmHg graduated compression built for nurses, CNAs, and home health aides.

## Safety and monitoring

- [AirGuard™ Fall-Detection Collar](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20AirGuard%20Collar.html): Senses a fall the instant it happens and calls for help automatically.
- [MEND Pulse — Wireless Blood Pressure Monitor](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20MEND%20Pulse.html): Clinical-grade monitor that syncs every reading to the care team.
- [MEND Oxi — Fingertip Pulse Oximeter](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20MEND%20Oxi.html): Clinical-grade oximeter that syncs every SpO₂ and pulse-rate reading.
- [MEND App](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Product%20Detail%20-%20MEND%20App.html): Connects every MEND device to the care team through a HIPAA-compliant pipeline.

## Tools and information

- [Fall Risk Check](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/fall-risk-assessment.html): A free STEADI-based self-assessment with a WHO fall-mortality data panel. No account required.
- [FAQ](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/FAQ.html): Sizing, fabric care, shipping, and returns.
- [Privacy Policy & Terms of Use](https://www.mendmedicalwear.com/Privacy-Terms.html)

## Notes

- Canonical host is www.mendmedicalwear.com. The apex 308-redirects to it.
- The Fall Risk Check is informational and is not a medical diagnosis.
